name: connect-wallet-pill
purpose: The fleet's wallet connect button: one pill that walks connect -> busy (spinner) -> connected chip (identicon + truncated address + optional NIM balance), with a tap-twice disconnect. A small vanilla driver (initConnectPill) takes a pluggable async connect callback, designed for the nimiq-app-shell createWallet seam. Replaces 6 divergent bespoke connect buttons.

props.name: connect
props.description: The only integration point. Sit it on nimiq-app-shell: connect: () => wallet.connect(). Resolve null on cancel (or when a mobile redirect is in flight) and the pill returns to idle. No hard dependency on the app-shell: any async callback works.

props.name: onDisconnect
props.description: Called after the user confirms disconnect on the chip (e.g. wallet.disconnect()).

props.name: account
props.description: Initial account: restores a persisted session straight into the connected chip.

props.name: identicon
props.description: Identicon resolver. Default: window.Iqons.toDataUrl when @nimiq/iqons is loaded (pinned 1.6.0, house recipe), else the hexagon placeholder.

props.name: formatBalance
props.description: Balance formatter. Default: thin-space grouped NIM ('1 234 NIM'); strings pass through.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called when the connect callback rejects (the pill returns to idle). Default: console.error.

props.name: class: on-dark
props.description: On navy surfaces (e.g. inside app-header): flat white-alpha pill (the shipped .nq-button-s.inverse alphas) instead of the navy radial.

notes: ORIGINAL composition (flag-hex precedent), so verified:false; reference.png is still snapped from truth/truth.html and nq verify guards the demo against it (both surfaces, all three states) as a regression check. There is no upstream connect button: the wallet/hub own the other side of the popup, so this formalizes the best fleet pattern (hashmark renderTopbarAddress, a 3-state topbar chip whose CSS was off-brand) on shipped nq tokens. Design decisions: (1) Every surface is a shipped token, nothing invented: idle = the navy radial pill (nq-button-pill treatment, bottom-right anchor, darkened-gradient hover via the nq-button ::before pattern); connected/confirm = the quiet .nq-button-s surface (navy .07 rest, .12 hover) because a connected chip is status, not a call to action; on-dark = the shipped .nq-button-s.inverse alphas (white .2 rest, .25 hover; flat fills are canonical for white/secondary pills; white .2 rather than a bespoke lower alpha because it is the real shipped inverse token). (2) Type is the nq-button-s scale (14px/700 Mulish) written in px so the 8px-root rem trap cannot bite; height is 32px, raised from the legacy 27px to clear nq lint's 30px mobile tap floor. (3) The spinner is the CircleSpinner arc geometry (upstream vue-components) recolored via currentColor per the icon rule, with prefers-reduced-motion handling; busy keeps the surface (no disabled-gray flash for a sub-second popup roundtrip). (4) The address is a technical value: Fira Mono, uppercase, truncated to the first 7 + last 5 characters of the space-formatted address around an ellipsis (NQ87 JY...CVN2); the full formatted address rides in title. Optional balance sits one opacity step down (60%, wallet text ladder) with thin-space grouping. (5) Disconnect stays radically simple: tap the chip and it flips to a Disconnect label (confirm state, same quiet surface since red = error only and disconnecting is not an error), tap again to disconnect; outside click, Escape, or 4s reverts. One element, no menu. (6) Identicon via the house iqons recipe (pinned @nimiq/iqons@1.6.0 on jsdelivr, vendored team-shipped iqons.min.svg sprite with byte-identical CDN fallback, see swap-balance-bar); the driver falls back to the hexagon placeholder when iqons is absent, and races nothing: the chip renders immediately on the placeholder and swaps in the iqon (guarded against stale renders). (7) Keyboard focus = the house 2px blue ring outside the pill (:focus-visible; 0CA6FE on dark per rule 20). The one calculated break is the identicon itself. Driver returns { state, account, setAccount, setBalance, disconnect, destroy }; setAccount wires wallet.onAccountChange (the hashmark mobile-redirect return path). Fleet refs: hashmark-test-pool app/src/client/main.ts renderTopbarAddress, nimiq-app-shell src/wallet (createWallet/Account), tipjar identicon placeholder. Pairs with app-header (mount in its tools slot with class on-dark).
